text:
Jordan: heads-up — I'm swapping primary for the 3/28 overnight window. available until 02:30 UTC, then need coverage until 09:00 UTC.
Priya: ok noted. who is secondary for that window today?
Jordan: @Alex is listed as secondary but Alex is on PTO from 03/28 per calendar. I pinged them earlier.
Alex: confirmed i'm on PTO all day 03/28, can't be on call. sorry missed the note.
Priya: thanks for confirming. Sam — can you take secondary for 02:30–09:00 UTC?
Sam: I can cover 04:00–09:00 UTC but not the 02:30–04:00 gap. early meeting.
Jordan: hm — that leaves 02:30–04:00 uncovered. Incident Bot: SCHEDULE REMINDER: upcoming on-call shift for team eng-oncall — primary Jordan 03/28 00:00–09:00 UTC, secondary Alex (PTO) flagged.
Priya: tagging rotation leads — @Jordan @Sam — if we can't fill 02:30–04:00 we should set automatic fallback to the SRE rotation. Is everyone ok with that?
Sam: I can shift earlier if needed, but only if someone else can take 06:00–09:00 in exchange. trade proposal: Sam takes 02:30–06:00, Jordan picks up 06:00–09:00?
Jordan: I prefer to avoid multiple swaps. alternative: set SRE as fallback just for the 02:30–04:00 slice, then we revert to regular secondary at 04:00. that's simplest.
Priya: agreed — do we have runbook steps to set fallback? I can do it now. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-fallback. key command below.
Priya: ```pagerduty-cli rotation override --rotation eng-oncall --start 2025-03-28T02:30:00Z --end 2025-03-28T04:00:00Z --target rotation:sre-oncall```
Priya: after that, update the oncall calendar event and post confirmation here. also add a note in the incident channel so customers see fallback in status page if any alerts start.
Incident Bot: ACTION LOG — fallback override requested by Priya at 2025-03-26T18:20:15Z. pending approval from rotation owners.
Alex: approved via DM. I'm fine with SRE taking the short slice.
Sam: approved. I'm still willing to shift earlier if Priya prefers.
Jordan: thanks all. Priya — please proceed with the override and paste the pagerduty change id. Also please add quick runbook pointer for responders: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/primary-secondary-handoff (section "short coverage fallback").
Priya: done — override applied. PagerDuty change id: PD-987654321. I updated the oncall calendar and pinned a note in #incidents with the fallback window.
Jordan: confirmed I see PD-987654321 and calendar updated. I'll monitor 00:00–02:30 and then hand off to SRE at 02:30.
Sam: will be online 03:50 UTC and take over at 04:00.
Jordan: leaving a quick checklist for whoever responds: 1) check logs via /infra/logs for spike tags ("latency" "v2-inference"); 2) if error budget burned, escalate to eng-sre; 3) use rollback policy in runbook section 3.2.
Priya: added checklist to pinned note. final ask: Jordan — please confirm you'd like the post-shift blameless notes template posted tomorrow.
Jordan: yes please — I'll write a short blameless for the swap + coverage decision. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: THREAD CLOSED — rotation override applied and notifications sent.
